presentation.label: FILTER BANK
presentation.summary: Ladder, SEM, isolator and vowel filters.
presentation.overview: Four filter voices in one FX1 slot. Move between a ladder filter, a SEM-style state-variable filter, an isolator and a vowel filter, with envelope and LFO modulation.
highlights: Ladder, SEM, isolator and vowel modes
usage: Choose SPECTRUM in FX1. MODE selects ladder, SEM, isolator or vowel filtering.
In SEM mode, SHPE moves between low-pass, band-pass and high-pass. FREQ controls cutoff; RES controls resonance.
Use ENV for envelope response and LDP / LSP for LFO modulation. Start with low resonance, then raise it while monitoring the output.

controls.name: FREQ
controls.doc: the cutoff, 60 Hz..15 kHz exponential; in VOWL the vowel A-E-I-O-U; ENV and LFO move it

controls.name: RES
controls.doc: the flavour: resonance in SEM/LADR, sharpness in VOWL, the dielectric colour in ISO

controls.name: ENV
controls.doc: the envelope follower onto the cutoff, drawn -64..+63; 0 = none

controls.name: LDP
controls.doc: LFO depth onto the cutoff, 0 = none (a negative depth would only flip the phase)

controls.name: LSP
controls.doc: LFO speed ~0.08..9 Hz, and the envelope release (0 slow .. 127 fast)

controls.name: WDTH
controls.doc: stereo width of the output, drawn -64..+63: 0 untouched, -64 mono, +63 double sides

controls.name: MODE
controls.doc: LADR the Moog (first); SEM the SVF (SHPE: LP -> BP -> HP); ISO (Capacitor2); VOWL

controls.name: SHPE
controls.doc: SEM only: 0 lowpass, 64 bandpass, 127 highpass, crossfaded; --- in the other modes
